title: Register the 2026-09-07 IMP-393/398 guidance refresh and two-file immutable overlay

outcomes.statement: The exact seven-path substrate guidance refresh is carried under technical ownership, CLAUDE.md and FRONTEND.md are admitted through an immutable two-file overlay, generated mirrors retain their provenance trailers, and the guidance checker rejects active tenant_id instructions without rejecting explicit statements that tenant_id must not be used.
outcomes.demo: Verify the seven delivered paths retain their substrate bytes, the CHG-053 manifest and desired copies bind the exact CLAUDE.md and FRONTEND.md states, focused reconciliation fixtures accept the delivered negative tenant_id guidance while rejecting an active tenant_id instruction and unknown hashes, REVIEWED_RECONCILER_SHA256 matches the reviewed reconciler, and generated-guidance plus lint are green without editing AGENTS.md, SECURITY.md, or STANDARDS.md.

uncertainties.statement: Whether the two unknown generated states can be accepted without editing the substrate-emitted targets.
uncertainties.resolution: Use the exact delivered CLAUDE.md and FRONTEND.md bytes as immutable desired copies under CHG-053, source them from the final CHG-049 layer, and register only that closed transition in the reconciler.

uncertainties.statement: Whether the delivered negative references to tenant_id are active forbidden guidance.
uncertainties.resolution: They explicitly prohibit tenant_id rather than instruct its use. Narrow the checker with focused red/green fixtures so active tenant_id guidance remains rejected while the exact negative forms emitted by Nous are accepted.

uncertainties.statement: Whether the reconciler trust pin and protected mirror behavior remain closed after registering the layer.
uncertainties.resolution: Review the minimal reconciler delta, update its focused tests, compute and re-pin REVIEWED_RECONCILER_SHA256, and verify mirror bodies preserve their individual terminal provenance trailers.
